notice: SYNTHETIC TEST DATA. OSM/SUMO do not publish hospital kit stock, zone demand, patient-transfer demand, background lane flow, or measured road capacity. Every number below is a configurable test value and must be replaced with owner-provided data before operational use.

units.kit_trips: one ambulance trip carrying kits_per_trip (10) kits
units.beds: one free emergency bed (receiving capacity, not shipped)

Z1.note: Real hospital location used as the Z1 delivery/patient origin anchor; its lane is in the main strongly connected component.

Z2.note: Real hospital location used as the Z2 delivery/patient origin anchor; its lane is in the main strongly connected component.

Z3.note: Real hospital location used as the Z3 delivery/patient origin anchor; its lane is in the main strongly connected component.

Z4.note: Real hospital location used as the Z4 delivery/patient origin anchor; its lane is in the main strongly connected component.

background_note: No measured lane-level ordinary traffic is available in the repository. The shipped value is zero. A real deployment must replace this with a lane-flow table; background flow is never mixed into the ambulance total.
synthetic_choices: One active kit source (al-mabara-hospital) carries 20 kits and the other active sources carry 10, producing 180 total kits against 170 zone demand. The resulting 10-kit surplus is shown as a dummy destination in the transportation tableau.
Kit supplies are zero at dead-end sources and at clinics, because those facilities cannot both dispatch a vehicle and act as an emergency kit source under the owner policies.
Zone kit demand and patient demand are unequal test values, not measured demand.
The background flow is zero rather than invented.
